# Upstream source provenance

This is the same alacritty_terminal 0.26.1-dev package from https://github.com/zed-industries/alacritty at revision 4c129667ce56611becdc82de6e28218c80e2e88f. UPSTREAM-files.json records every original and imported filename, content hash and intentional change. All 206 original regular files and 181 test/reference entries are retained; fixture bytes and paths are unchanged.

Four module filenames are transparently mapped before creation: src/grid/mod.rs to src/grid.rs, src/term/mod.rs to src/term.rs, src/tty/mod.rs to src/tty.rs, and src/tty/windows/mod.rs to src/tty/windows.rs. These filename mappings preserve the logical module hierarchy; subsequent body changes are recorded below and in UPSTREAM-files.json. No mod.rs path is materialized.

The reviewed local deltas include a mutable Unix child accessor for original-actor pinning before the existing event loop starts. The prior reviewed local deltas are the Unix opt-in exact child environment/checked-cwd API and two tests, nine selection assertion formatting hunks, and generic equality/UTF8 test failure messages which retain the exact predicates without logging environment maps. The imported Unix passwd fallback now groups the three environment results before using the same passwd error only when a fallback is needed. The existing synchronous PTY fd constructor has a function-scoped `expect(clippy::disallowed_methods)` because its std Child/SIGCHLD API runs on Zed’s background executor; no workspace or crate lint level is relaxed. Package metadata makes its original rust-version explicit and its copied readme local; original name/version/features/dependencies/authors and publication policy are preserved. UPSTREAM-Cargo.toml retains the original manifest.

The Windows direct-program prerequisite adds an optional explicit application path, CRT command/argument quoting only for that mode, a mutable CreateProcessW command buffer, and an opt-in exact environment API matching the existing Unix entrypoint. Legacy application selection and inherited environment behavior remain the defaults. Four Windows component tests cover literal command lines, empty exact environments and removal versus inheritance. At the initial preparation checkpoint these tests were written but uncompiled/unrun. Source-specific cross-compilation is recorded separately from actual Windows execution; no Windows process, Task, ConPTY or platform certification is claimed by this source change.

LICENSE-APACHE links to the parent license checker path ../../LICENSE-APACHE. That parent text is not byte-identical to upstream. UPSTREAM-LICENSE-APACHE and UPSTREAM-LICENSE-MIT retain both exact original license texts; original authors are retained in Cargo.toml. Generated notices and parent license compliance remain required qualification.

Preparation checkpoint (historical): this privately prepared source passed formatting and no-fuzz local-content patch restoration, not compilation/runtime/signing or platform certification. Seven original Unix tests plus two prepared new tests is source inventory; compiled --list is required. Native authority, loader/complete-map policy, actual child/queue/cancel, visible application, Samply/network, Intel, physical, accessibility and performance evidence remain separate.

Subsequent parent qualification records compiled backend140/default and139/no-default cases,45 byte-preserved reference cases, nine Unix regression cases under both feature sets, and strict repository backend lint. Exact Terminal/TerminalView runtime, actual inherited-environment negative controls, bounded failed-spawn privacy correction, license-generation and current-source receipts are maintained separately in [milestone evidence](../../.agents/evidence-archives/rust-workspace/native-terminal-environment-20261008/README.md). These checks do not activate the upper native issuer or certify shipping/signing, nonmacOS execution, physical transport, spoken readers or production frames.
